_note: Fictional newspapers per docs/fictionalization.md. See data/outlets/FRA.json for the field conventions. Two things are authored here that the other two files do not say. FIRST: `workers` is reached by two titles pulling in opposite directions, and the larger of the two is the one on the right -- a popular paper whose readers are not its politics, which is the case the per-bloc audience field exists to be able to express at all. SECOND: `students` has NO national title, deliberately. A bloc with no press gets the negative of the national mean in media.gd, so it is un-amplified rather than merely average, and leaving one bloc empty in content means that path is exercised by a real game and not only by a test.
